Messages.Author: Steven Bauer
Messages.Body:
Can a Methuselah play reaction cards on a minion controlled be another
Methuselah. (Specifically can be predator play wake with evening
freshness on my prey)

My friend says he can and I couldn't find any place in the rules where
it says he can't but it does not seem right to me.

Also can the Methuselah calling a vote turn in voting cards for votes.
The rules read "an of the pther Methuselahs" but I wasn't sure.

Thanks in advance,

Steven Bauer
email: ba...@wiliki.eng.hawaii.edu

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <DAEE4...@news.hawaii.edu>,

Steven Bauer <ba...@wiliki.eng.hawaii.edu> wrote:
>Can a Methuselah play reaction cards on a minion controlled be another
>Methuselah. (Specifically can be predator play wake with evening
>freshness on my prey)

No. You can only play reaction cards on your own minions.

>Also can the Methuselah calling a vote turn in voting cards for votes.
>The rules read "an of the pther Methuselahs" but I wasn't sure.

All Methuselahs (including the acting Methuselah) can burn PAs for votes.
